decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software remains core to the firm's data-driven, web-based infrastructure management strategy and is cheap to maintain.
Although it overlaps with Product A and could eventually be merged, software close to the core offer has low upkeep and serves existing installed customers.
The manhole door with safety railing is a standardized hardware module that meets steady safety demand from municipal water operators.
The floating sludge extractor complements the firm's wastewater machinery line and supports its project business with utilities.
Flow measurement automation software is close to the core offer and fits the move toward connected, data-driven operation.
